<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?> <FrameLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android" xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content">
<androidx.core.widget.NestedScrollView android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:fillViewport="true">
<LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="vertical" android:paddingHorizontal="20dp" android:paddingTop="16dp" android:paddingBottom="24dp">
<View android:layout_width="40dp" android:layout_height="4dp" android:layout_gravity="center_horizontal" android:layout_marginBottom="16dp" android:background="@color/lightgrey" />
<TextView android:id="@+id/settleTitleTV" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:fontFamily="@font/montserratalternatess_bold" android:text="Settle Transaction" android:textColor="@color/darkBlue" android:textSize="18sp" />
<TextView android:id="@+id/settleTotalTV" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="2dp" android:fontFamily="@font/montserratalternatess_regular" android:textColor="@color/grey" android:textSize="13sp" />
<View android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="1dp" android:layout_marginTop="16dp" android:background="@color/lightgrey" />
<LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="12dp" android:gravity="center_vertical" android:orientation="horizontal">
<LinearLayout android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_weight="1" android:orientation="vertical">
<TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:fontFamily="@font/montserratalternatess_bold" android:text="Payment Status" android:textColor="@color/darkBlue" android:textSize="18sp" />
<TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="2dp" android:fontFamily="@font/montserratalternatess_regular" android:text="Review current paid amounts and statuses." android:textColor="@color/grey" android:textSize="12sp" /> </LinearLayout>
<TextView android:id="@+id/settleAdvancedToggleTV" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:fontFamily="@font/montserratalternatess_bold" android:paddingHorizontal="8dp" android:paddingVertical="6dp" android:text="Show" android:textColor="@color/darkBlue" android:textSize="12sp" /> </LinearLayout>
<LinearLayout android:id="@+id/settleAdvancedContainer" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="10dp" android:orientation="vertical" android:visibility="gone">
<androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView android:id="@+id/settlePayorsRecyclerView" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:nestedScrollingEnabled="false" /> </LinearLayout>
<View android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="1dp" android:layout_marginVertical="16dp" android:background="@color/lightgrey" />
<TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:fontFamily="@font/montserratalternatess_bold" android:text="Summary" android:textColor="@color/darkBlue" android:textSize="18sp" />
<LinearLayout android:id="@+id/settleSummaryContainer" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginStart="8dp" android:orientation="vertical" android:paddingVertical="10dp" android:visibility="gone" />
<View android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="1dp" android:layout_marginVertical="16dp" android:background="@color/lightgrey" />
<TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:fontFamily="@font/montserratalternatess_bold" android:text="Settlement" android:textColor="@color/darkBlue" android:textSize="18sp" />
<TextView android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="4dp" android:fontFamily="@font/montserratalternatess_regular" android:text="Choose who pays whom and how much." android:textColor="@color/grey" android:textSize="12sp" />
<LinearLayout android:id="@+id/settleInstructionContainer" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="10dp" android:orientation="vertical" />
<com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton android:id="@+id/settleAddInstructionBtn" app:backgroundTint="@null" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="8dp" android:background="@drawable/round_border_glassy" android:fontFamily="@font/montserratalternatess_bold" android:paddingHorizontal="18dp" android:text="Add Payment" android:textAllCaps="false" android:textColor="@color/darkBlue" />
<LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="12dp" android:background="@drawable/round_border_glassy" android:orientation="vertical" android:padding="14dp">
<TextView android:id="@+id/settleAssignedTV" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:fontFamily="@font/montserratalternatess_bold" android:text="Assigned: ₱ 0" android:textColor="@color/darkBlue" android:textSize="13sp" />
<TextView android:id="@+id/settleRemainingTV" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="4dp" android:fontFamily="@font/montserratalternatess_bold" android:text="Remaining to assign: ₱ 0" android:textColor="@color/red" android:textSize="13sp" />
<TextView android:id="@+id/settleInstructionMessageTV" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="6dp" android:fontFamily="@font/montserratalternatess_regular" android:textColor="@color/grey" android:textSize="11sp" /> </LinearLayout>
<View android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="1dp" android:layout_marginVertical="16dp" android:background="@color/lightgrey" />
<LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="horizontal">
<com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton android:id="@+id/settleCancelBtn" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginEnd="8dp" android:layout_weight="1" android:background="@drawable/round_border_glassy" android:fontFamily="@font/montserratalternatess_bold" android:text="Cancel" android:textColor="@color/darkBlue" app:backgroundTint="@null" />
<com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton android:id="@+id/settleSaveBtn" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginBottom="8dp" android:layout_weight="1" android:background="@drawable/rounded_button_selector" android:fontFamily="@font/montserratalternatess_bold" android:text="Save" android:textColor="@color/whitest" app:backgroundTint="@null" /> </LinearLayout>
</LinearLayout> </androidx.core.widget.NestedScrollView>
<FrameLayout android:id="@+id/settleLoadingLayout" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent" android:background="@color/glassy_background" android:clickable="true" android:focusable="true" android:visibility="gone">
<LinearLayout android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_gravity="center" android:gravity="center" android:orientation="vertical">
<ProgressBar android:id="@+id/settlement_progressBar" style="@style/CustomProgressBarStyle" android:layout_width="48dp" android:layout_height="48dp" />
<TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="12dp" android:fontFamily="@font/montserratalternatess_regular" android:text="Saving settlement..." android:textColor="@color/darkBlue" android:textSize="14sp" /> </LinearLayout> </FrameLayout>
</FrameLayout>
